svg.title: Barber — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as barber, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: Electric clippers with exposed cutting teeth sit beside an open straight razor. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, an oval face and round glasses.
